about: Keys the mashup adds or takes over. Left mouse fires the held gun, right mouse aims (sniper: scope). Q (Minecraft's drop key) drops the held item, e.g. to free a slot.

rows.action: when eliminated/spectating: go back to the hub early
toggle the full island map (Minecraft's player list key; the player list is gone). On the map: left-click places your waypoint, right-click removes it
toggle build mode (uses Wood/Brick/Metal); press again to go back to weapons
outside matches: open the Locker (hats, shirts, pants, shoes, particle effects; cosmetic only)
during the drop: open or close the glider (it opens by itself at the glider height if never opened)
hold next to a knocked teammate to revive them, or at a reboot van with reboot cards to bring teammates back (F no longer swaps your offhand)
